literature_shortlist: Reuse all ten prior locked internally validated candidates, ordered by existing descriptive priority; require primary global q<0.05 and audit status not_identified_in_reviewed_annotation_catalogs. No claim of exhaustive literature absence.
heterogeneity_family: All eligible category pairs for every exact syndrome and all 120 features, irrespective of primary significance; expected 1,920 tests
contrast: (case mean A - reference mean A) - (case mean B - reference mean B), in original feature units
test: Two-sided generalized Welch-Satterthwaite four-independent-group linear contrast. SE^2=sum(s_i^2/n_i); df=(sum v_i)^2/sum(v_i^2/(n_i-1)); t=contrast/SE
adjustment: Separate BH family over all 1,920 contrasts; supplementary BY adjustment over same family for arbitrary dependence. Original 9,600 primary q values unchanged.
recommendation_filter: Interaction BH q<0.05; at least one original primary global q<0.05; rank BY-passing first, then interaction BH q, decreasing abs(t), exact disease/feature/race keys; retain one comparison per syndrome/anatomical trait family until ten
additional_undercharacterized_list: Same filter and ranking, additionally require at least one category pair member missing from reviewed annotation catalogs; no re-correction of filtered rows
limitations: Approximate mean test with small cells, normality/independence assumptions, selected follow-up display, correlated traits/shared reference groups, unadjusted age/sex/source/pose. Relative-to-reference mean gaps, not tests of primary Mann-Whitney estimand or Hedges g equality. Recorded labels, not biological ancestry or causal effects.
privacy: All real outputs in verified ignored local_review/followup_recommendations_20261115; no raw patient data or manuscript modifications
